job_summary: Define SAP functional solutions, lead client workshops and preserve design continuity from presales through deployment and stabilization. Candidates need nine to twelve years of SAP experience, three years with current S/4HANA releases, a relevant degree and French and English communication skills. Client travel within Canada and the United States may occupy thirty to fifty percent of working time during pursuit and design phases.
job_responsibilities:
• Reporting to the Senior Director, SAP Presales and Alliance, the SAP Customer Solution Director is part of the SAP practice and serves as the functional design authority for clients and delivery teams. The role maintains solution continuity from the earliest pursuit and presales discussions through delivery, user acceptance testing, go-live and support, helping ensure that the solution sold remains consistent with the solution designed and delivered.
• Working at the intersection of business development, presales and delivery, you translate complex business challenges into an SAP solution that can be built, estimated and aligned with the client’s industry. You own process design and the industry response, while technical architecture remains with the Solution Architect or Enterprise Architect and execution, staffing and margin remain with project management and delivery leadership. Your influence, judgement and deep SAP S/4HANA knowledge contribute directly to client satisfaction and sales growth.
• Your mission consists of:
• Client orientation and business value: Lead functional solutioning for pursuits, requests for proposal and oral presentations by translating client business problems into an SAP solution that Talan can estimate and deliver.
• Build and defend the value case with business stakeholders, including benefit drivers, baseline measures and the operational changes required to realize the expected value.
• Advise decision-makers and, when appropriate, recommend a no-bid decision when industry fit or client readiness does not support a responsible proposal.
• Business development and influence: Define solution assumptions, scope boundaries, exclusions and functional inputs to estimates, then challenge estimates before they are incorporated into pricing.
• Design and present, with Alliance and Presales teams, industry-relevant demonstrations, accelerators and proof-of-concept scenarios.
• Support joint pursuits, industry positioning and engagement with SAP account teams and ecosystem partners.
• Design leadership and risk management: Act as the functional design authority, decide on process design and fit-to-standard matters, and chair or co-chair workshops focused on critical processes.
• Provide a documented transition from the sold solution to the delivery team, including the assumption register, scope baseline and design intent.
• Serve as an escalation point when scope, industry fit or process design is at risk, and support the rationale for required changes.
• Delivery excellence: Review and approve process design deliverables before they are submitted to the client for sign-off.
• Validate the delivered design against the original value case through user acceptance testing, go-live and stabilization.
• Advise the team on organizational impacts arising from process design in partnership with the change management lead.
• Collaboration and practice development: Coach functional consultants and domain leads to strengthen the team’s ability to hold credible industry conversations with clients.
• Advance the industry intellectual property roadmap, including process models, configuration accelerators, demo scenarios and client references.
• Feed delivery lessons into leads, packaged offerings, accelerators and the process content used by AI-enabled delivery tools.
experience_required:
• Experience : Nine (9) to twelve (12) years of relevant SAP experience in functional, solution design or process architecture roles.
• SAP delivery record : Participation in at least four full-cycle SAP implementations, including at least two as a functional lead or solution owner.
• Industry expertise : Deep experience in the industry named in the posting and command of its associated end-to-end processes.
• SAP S/4HANA : At least three (3) years of experience with current S/4HANA releases in public or private cloud, including demonstrated fit-to-standard practice.
• Estimating and delivery : Demonstrated experience defining assumptions, scope and effort estimates that a delivery team was accountable for executing.
• Executive advisory : Experience leading oral presentations, executive workshops and value discussions with VP- or C-level business stakeholders.
• Education : Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Information Technology or a related field.
• Communication : Good oral and written communication skills, in French and English, to communicate with clients located across North America.
• Experience in the specific industry vertical aligned to the role, with a strong understanding of end-to-end business processes and industry-specific SAP solutions.
• Mining :
• Mine-to-cash end to end, including ore movement, production reporting, and cost per tonne
• Plant maintenance, asset management, MRO, and warehouse for asset-intensive operations
• Concentrate and commodity sales, including provisional pricing and weight and assay settlement
• Royalties, offtake agreements, and shipment reconciliation
• Integration boundaries with mine planning, fleet management, and metallurgical accounting systems
• Oil and Gas:
• Well-to-wallet end to end
• Hydrocarbon product management, including quantity conversion and inventory valuation
• Joint venture accounting and production revenue accounting
• Exchanges, tariffs, and netback calculation
• Secondary distribution and downstream logistics processes
• CPG:
• Demand planning and S&OP
• Trade promotion planning, execution, settlement, deductions, and claims
• Revenue growth management and pricing and rebate structures
• Customer Activity Repository and demand data foundation
• DSD, batch traceability, quality management, and recall readiness
• Retailer EDI, GS1 standards, and allocation under constrained supply
• Industrial Manufacturing:
• Plan-to-produce end to end
• Engineer-to-order and configure-to-order flows, including variant configuration
• Production planning and detailed scheduling, and MRP in S/4HANA
• Quality management and non-conformance handling
• Service parts, warranty, and installed base
• Project systems on capital work and long-cycle manufacturing

Vous êtes administrateur(trice) de bases de données PostgreSQL et aimez résoudre des problèmes complexes de performance, améliorer la fiabilité des bases de données et travailler avec des systèmes qui soutiennent des applications SaaS utilisées à grande échelle?
Explorance est à la recherche d’un(e) administrateur(trice) de bases de données PostgreSQL pour se joindre à notre équipe mondiale CloudOps à Montréal.
Dans ce rôle pratique et technique, vous contribuerez à la gestion et à l’amélioration continue des environnements PostgreSQL qui soutiennent nos applications SaaS. Vous travaillerez sur différents aspects, allant de l’optimisation des performances et de la haute disponibilité à l’automatisation, la sécurité, la sauvegarde et la récupération, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes CloudOps, de développement et d’autres équipes techniques.
Nous recherchons une personne possédant une solide expérience avec PostgreSQL, qui aime résoudre des problèmes, qui fait preuve d’autonomie et de responsabilisation, et qui souhaite continuer à développer son expertise en matière de bases de données et d’opérations infonuagiques.
Vos principales responsabilités
Administration et fiabilité de PostgreSQL
Administrer et maintenir les bases de données PostgreSQL dans les environnements de développement, de test et de production.
Contribuer à assurer la haute disponibilité, la fiabilité, la sécurité et la performance de nos bases de données.
Participer aux mises à niveau et aux migrations de bases de données ainsi qu’aux projets d’amélioration de l’infrastructure.
Contribuer aux décisions liées à l’architecture et à la conception des bases de données à mesure que nos applications et notre infrastructure évoluent.
Performance et optimisation
Surveiller l’état des bases de données et identifier les goulots d’étranglement en matière de performance avant qu’ils ne deviennent problématiques.
Analyser et optimiser les requêtes à l’aide d’outils PostgreSQL tels que EXPLAIN et ANALYZE .
Améliorer l’indexation, les schémas, les configurations et les scripts de déploiement afin d’accroître la performance et la fiabilité.
Collaborer avec les équipes de développement sur la conception des bases de données et l’optimisation des requêtes.
Haute disponibilité, sauvegarde et récupération
Soutenir et améliorer les environnements PostgreSQL à haute disponibilité, notamment les mécanismes de réplication et les technologies de basculement automatisé.
Maintenir les processus de sauvegarde, de récupération et de reprise après sinistre.
Valider régulièrement les sauvegardes et les procédures de récupération afin de nous assurer qu’elles sont pleinement fonctionnelles lorsque nous en avons besoin.
Automatisation et surveillance
Automatiser les tâches répétitives d’administration de bases de données à l’aide de Bash, PowerShell ou d’outils similaires.
Améliorer la surveillance et l’observabilité des bases de données.
Soutenir la planification de la capacité et l’analyse de l’utilisation des ressources.
Améliorer continuellement nos processus opérationnels et notre documentation technique.
Sécurité et soutien à la production
Gérer les accès aux bases de données, les autorisations, les audits, la journalisation et les autres contrôles de sécurité.
Contribuer au maintien de la sécurité des bases de données et au respect des normes de sécurité de l’organisation.
Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes liés aux bases de données dans les environnements de production.
Participer, au besoin, aux activités planifiées de maintenance et de mise en production.
Ce que nous recherchons
Vous n’avez pas besoin de répondre à tous les critères. Si vous possédez une solide expérience avec PostgreSQL et répondez à la majorité des critères suivants, nous aimerions vous connaître :
Expérience professionnelle en administration de bases de données PostgreSQL dans des environnements de production .
Solide compréhension de l’architecture, de l’administration et du dépannage de PostgreSQL.
Expérience en optimisation des performances des bases de données et des requêtes .
Connaissance des concepts de sauvegarde, de récupération, de réplication et de haute disponibilité de PostgreSQL.
Connaissance de Patroni, de la réplication en continu ( streaming replication ) ou de la réplication logique.
Expérience de travail dans des environnements Linux et avec les scripts Bash/shell.
Compréhension des meilleures pratiques en matière de sécurité des bases de données et de gestion des accès.
Solides compétences en dépannage, en analyse et en résolution de problèmes.
Capacité à communiquer et à collaborer efficacement avec les développeurs et les autres équipes techniques.
Capacité à prendre en charge ses responsabilités de façon autonome tout en contribuant à un environnement d’équipe collaboratif.
Un diplôme en informatique, en technologies de l’information ou dans une discipline connexe constitue un atout, mais une expérience pratique équivalente est tout aussi pertinente.
Atouts
Une expérience dans l’un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants constitue un atout, mais n’est pas obligatoire :
Environnements de bases de données hébergés dans le nuage
Microsoft SQL Server
Redis ou technologies de mise en cache distribuée
Outils de surveillance et d’observabilité des bases de données
PL/pgSQL
ETL et intégration de données
PowerShell ou autres technologies d’automatisation
Planification de la capacité pour des environnements de bases de données en croissance
Pourquoi Explorance?
Vous vous joindrez à une équipe CloudOps mondiale où la fiabilité des bases de données contribue directement à la performance de nos produits SaaS et à l’expérience de nos clients.
Ce rôle vous permettra de travailler sur plusieurs aspects des opérations de bases de données, notamment l’administration, l’optimisation des performances, l’automatisation, la haute disponibilité, la sécurité et les opérations infonuagiques, plutôt que d’être limité(e) à un seul domaine du soutien aux bases de données.
Vous collaborerez également directement avec différentes équipes techniques au sein de l’organisation, ce qui vous donnera l’occasion de contribuer à l’évolution de nos environnements de bases de données au fur et à mesure de notre croissance.

Relevant experience supporting enterprise customers in one or more of the following: software implementation, customer onboarding, application engineering, business consulting, maintenance, reliability, operations, engineering, and/or construction.

BEng degree or equivalent years of experience.

We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.
ABOUT THE TEAM
Where you sit.
You'll be joining the Origination stream, the product area responsible for the end-to-end mortgage journey, covering self-serve and advisor-supported application flows, underwriting, decisioning, and funding.
This is a Senior PM role where part of your mandate is to help shape and own your specific substream within origination. You'll work closely with the stream lead, and together you'll define the boundaries of your focus area based on your strengths, the team's needs, and where the biggest opportunities are. It's a rare chance to have real influence over your own scope from day one.
Your closest collaborators will be engineering teams building on Nesto Cloud, mortgage operations and underwriting experts who live inside these processes daily, and the brokers and advisors who depend on these tools to serve clients.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
Act as one of the primary origination subject-matter experts for your substream, deeply understanding end-to-end origination processes, regulatory requirements, and operational realities.
Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and feature prioritization for your area, ensuring it reflects real-world origination requirements, operational efficiencies, and compliance considerations.
Identify and assess the impact of new lending features, regulatory changes, and origination workflow evolutions to help shape product direction and support strategic decisions.
Work closely with engineering, design, QA, operations, and compliance to validate designs and proposed solutions, ensuring they align with origination best practices and industry standards.
Support the backlog refinement process by prioritizing origination-related epics and stories, balancing customer experience, operational needs, and technical feasibility.
Participate in release planning, UAT, and pre-launch readiness to ensure origination use cases are fully supported, edge cases are addressed, and downstream impacts are understood.
Conduct research on industry trends, evolving regulations, origination technologies, and competitor approaches, bringing insights to guide product evolution.
Create and maintain detailed documentation of origination processes, scenarios, requirements, and system behaviours to support product teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
Act as the go-to expert for your origination workflows, answering questions, supporting issue triage, and ensuring the product supports exceptional origination experiences across all lending products.
AI-Augmented Ways of Working
Actively use AI tools (Cursor, Claude, Figma AI, Gemini, and others) to accelerate your PM workflow from discovery through delivery: synthesizing research, prototyping ideas, and measuring results.
Don't wait for a perfect process to test a hypothesis. Use the tools available to you to get to answers faster, whether that means building a rough prototype, running a quick experiment, or drafting a solution to pressure-test with users before it becomes a roadmap item.
Comfortable going beyond traditional PM boundaries when the situation calls for it, the best people here don't hand off and wait, they stay close to the work and use every tool at their disposal to move it forward.
Stay ahead of how AI is reshaping mortgage origination and bring informed recommendations to the roadmap.
Share what you discover. How you work should make the people around you better.
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
The profile.
5-7+ years of hands-on experience in product management, ideally with exposure to mortgage origination, lending, or a closely adjacent regulated financial services environment.
Understanding of end-to-end origination functions from application flows, document collection, underwriting, credit decisioning to compliance checkpoints, and funding processes.
Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements related to mortgage and consumer lending, including provincial regulations, OSFI guidelines, insurance requirements, and reporting obligations.
Experience working with origination platforms, LOS systems, or lending technology, with the ability to translate operational needs into functional system requirements.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, design, operations, compliance, and QA teams.
Exceptional problem-solving skills with an ability to anticipate downstream impacts and foresee edge cases in origination workflows.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex origination concepts clearly to non-experts in Product and Engineering.
Proven, active fluency with AI tools across your PM workflow : discovery, testing, documentation, analysis, and measurement. We will ask you specifically how you use them.
PREFERRED BUT NOT A MUST
Experience with other lending products such as HELOC, personal loans, private lending, reverse mortgages, or construction financing.
Familiarity with broker and advisor-facing workflows and the nuances of supported versus self-serve client journeys.
Exposure to AI or ML-assisted decisioning, document intelligence, or automation in a financial services context.
YOU SHOULDN'T APPLY IF
Be honest with yourself.
You're only comfortable in a well-defined product area. This role requires you to help shape your own scope: ambiguity is the starting condition, not an exception.
You treat AI tools as a curiosity rather than a daily accelerant.
You hand off a PRD and consider your job done. Ownership here runs from discovery all the way through to measuring results in production.
You don't thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and sometimes ambiguous environment.
You are not open to experimentation and continuous improvement.
INTERVIEW PROCESS
How we get to know each other.
Recruiter Screen – 30 minutes
Discovery Call with Director of Product – 30 minutes
Take-home Assignment followed by Presentation and Q&A – 60 minutes
Final Stakeholder Interview – 45 minutes

Tools for Success — Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.

At Nesto Group, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.
We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, members of racialized communities, women, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

Salesforce Administrator 

Location: Montreal, QC (Hybrid)

About us

Broadsign is a growing software company with a mission to make buying, selling, and delivering out-of-home media easier than ever. Our software is operated by some of the most successful out-of-home businesses and powers impactful, compelling campaigns seen across the world.

About the role

Key Roles and Responsibilities:

Platform Management & Configuration:

Perform day-to-day administration, configuration, and maintenance of the Salesforce instance to align with evolving business needs.

Create and maintain custom objects, fields, formulas, workflows, validation rules, and Process Builder and Flows to automate business processes.

Manage user profiles, roles, permissions, public groups, Organization-Wide Defaults, sharing rules, and security settings to ensure data integrity and compliance.

Assist our Sales Department with designing and maintaining lead assignment rules, opportunity workflows, and territory management to drive sales execution.

Conduct proactive system maintenance, including health checks, release readiness, and security reviews.

Participate in scoping and delivering prioritized configuration work.

Manage release/deployments of enhancements.

User Support & Training

Provide first-line support and troubleshooting assistance to end-users, ensuring timely resolution of issues.

Act as a Salesforce subject matter expert and trusted advisor for all internal users.

Support user onboarding/offboarding processes and access management.

Facilitate training sessions and create documentation to support staff in adopting new functionalities.

Data Management & Reporting

Oversee and analyze data to ensure data hygiene and integrity.

Perform bulk data updates, deduplication, and cleansing of data.

Develop and maintain custom reports, dashboards, and visualizations to provide valuable, actionable insights for decision-making and performance tracking.

Manage Salesforce data feeds, imports, and other integrations.

Manage integrations with various tools such as Gong, HubSpot, and Slack to enable real-time data flow and automation.

Collaboration & Process Improvement

Collaborate with stakeholders (including Sales, Marketing, Services, and Finance) to gather requirements, design solutions, and implement changes.

Work closely with the IT System Administrators to ensure consistent practices and methodologies are used.

Work closely with internal Stakeholders and any external vendors (e.g. Salesforce Development teams) to support the delivery of new features and enhancements.

Assist with UAT, testing coordination, and sandbox validation for deployments.

Identify opportunities to streamline business processes through configuration or automation.

Create and maintain documentation and playbooks for workflows, data flows, and system configurations to ensure long-term governance and clarity.

Skills and Qualifications

Education & Certifications

University Degree or College Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience is required.

Salesforce Certified Platform Foundations certification is required.

Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator certification, or the commitment to obtaining it within one year, is required.

Salesforce Certified System Architect certification is highly desirable.

Additional Salesforce certifications such as Agentforce Specialist, Business Analyst, or Platform Developer are considered a plus.

Any Information Technology-related certifications are considered an asset.

Experience

Minimum of 3-5 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator managing Salesforce environments.

Proven experience managing Salesforce environments supporting 100+ users for Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud.

Experience managing a small development team or working with outside consultants is a plus.

Experience with Agentforce, Data Cloud, Revenue Cloud,

Advanced skills in building custom apps and objects, formula fields, workflows, custom views, reports, and dashboards.  

Proficiency in applying advanced automation to solve complex business problems using Process Builder and Flows.

Experience with Salesforce integrations with 3rd party systems via API and their implications.

Skilled in data manipulation via Data Loader or similar tools.

Experience with QA/UAT in sandbox environments and using change sets/deployment tools (e.g., Gearset) to deploy to production.

Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and participating in structured change management.

Proficiency in Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, etc.) with expert-level skills preferred.

Experience with Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence) and ServiceNow is a strong asset.

Experience with development languages like Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, SOQL, and SOSL is a plus.

Soft Skills & Competencies

Excellent verbal, written, and visual communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to all organizational levels and non-technical teams.

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

A proactive, optimistic, and growth mindset with a commitment to scalability and user experience.

Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Strong interpersonal skills and a demonstrated ability to build collaborative relationships and obtain consensus among cross-functional partners.

A passion for user support, data integrity, and continuous improvement.

What we bring to the table

Wellness: $500 annual Wellness fund for mental/physical health and office-related expenses.

Comprehensive Benefits: Complete company insurance plan (health, dental, vision, travel) effective from day one (100% employer-paid). $500 annual Health Care Savings Account (HCSA).

Paid Time Off: 3 weeks vacation, 5 floater days, 5 sick/personal days, and 2 volunteer days.

Retirement Savings: Group RRSP with a 50% employer match up to 4% of your salary.

Growth Opportunities: Training & development budget to support your journey as a PM leader.

We recognize talent comes in different forms and encourage applications that reflect different backgrounds and experiences. Our promise is to be an inclusive employer and partner, open to learning, with thoughtful strategies and practices that amplify the different voices of our industry.

At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.

Responsable des incidents senior 

OneSpan est à la recherche d’un(e) Responsable des incidents senior hautement performant(e) pour se joindre à notre équipe de Montréal. OneSpan aide les organisations à transformer la façon dont elles sécurisent, signent et gèrent les ententes grâce à des solutions de pointe en vérification de l’identité numérique, signature électronique, formulaires intelligents, notarisation numérique et sécurité. 

Chez OneSpan, nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience client de calibre mondial. À titre de responsable des incidents senior - Amériques, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la gestion, la coordination et les communications liées aux incidents clients hautement prioritaires. 

Au sein de l’organisation du soutien à la clientèle, vous agirez comme point de contact central pour les incidents de priorité 1 et de priorité 2, en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes mondiales de soutien, d’ingénierie, de produit et des opérations. Votre capacité à mener les incidents à leur résolution, à communiquer efficacement avec les parties prenantes et à améliorer continuellement les processus de soutien aura un impact direct sur la réussite et la satisfaction des clients. 

Vous serez également responsable de la gestion des incidents majeurs dans la région des Amériques, de la coordination des escalades et des initiatives d’amélioration continue des services. Vous contribuerez à assurer l’harmonisation des pratiques régionales avec les normes opérationnelles et les meilleures pratiques à l’échelle mondiale. 

Ce que vous ferez 

Gestion des incidents majeurs 

Agir à titre de principal point de coordination et de communication pour tous les incidents de priorité 2 et de priorité 3. 

Agir comme premier niveau d’escalade pour les enjeux opérationnels nécessitant l’intervention d’un gestionnaire principal. 

Diriger les activités d’intervention en cas d’incident et assurer la mobilisation rapide des équipes techniques et des parties prenantes concernées. 

Coordonner les activités régionales dans le cadre d’incidents mondiaux pris en charge selon un modèle de soutien continu (« follow-the-sun »). 

Animer les cellules de gestion des incidents, coordonner les communications avec les parties prenantes et mener les revues post-incident. 

Piloter les incidents jusqu’à leur résolution, tout en accordant une attention particulière aux répercussions sur les clients et à la continuité des activités. 

  Excellence opérationnelle et amélioration des processus 

Assurer l’exécution et l’amélioration continue du processus de gestion des incidents. 

Surveiller le rendement des incidents par rapport aux engagements de niveau de service et aux procédures d’escalade convenus. 

Analyser les données des billets, les tendances opérationnelles et les indicateurs de soutien afin de cerner les occasions d’amélioration. 

Effectuer des revues d’incidents et de cas afin d’améliorer la qualité du service et l’efficacité opérationnelle. 

Établir et piloter des initiatives d’amélioration continue touchant les personnes, les processus, les outils et la technologie. 

Assurer la conformité aux normes mondiales de soutien, aux procédures opérationnelles et aux meilleures pratiques. 

Rapports et gestion du rendement 

Élaborer et tenir à jour des tableaux de bord d’indicateurs clés de performance (KPI), des rapports et des sommaires destinés à la direction. 

Assurer le suivi des tendances liées aux incidents, de la performance des services et des initiatives d’amélioration. 

Produire régulièrement des rapports sur la performance opérationnelle, les répercussions sur les clients et l’avancement des initiatives d’amélioration des processus. 

Représentation des intérêts des clients 

Agir comme partenaire de confiance et représenter les intérêts des clients lors de situations critiques. 

Assurer des communications claires, rapides et transparentes tout au long du cycle de vie des incidents. 

Veiller en tout temps à la sécurité, à la confidentialité et à l’intégrité des systèmes et des renseignements des clients. 

Votre profil 

Qualifications requises 

Baccalauréat en informatique, en technologies de l’information ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente. 

Plus de 6 ans d’expérience en soutien à la clientèle, soutien technique, gestion des incidents ou opérations de service. 

Expérience en soutien de solutions SaaS, infonuagiques, de cybersécurité ou de logiciels d’entreprise. 

Solide connaissance des pratiques de gestion des incidents et de gestion des services. 

Excellentes aptitudes en communication orale et écrite, avec la capacité de communiquer efficacement tant avec des équipes techniques qu’avec des membres de la haute direction. 

Excellentes compétences analytiques, organisationnelles et de résolution de problèmes. 

Forte orientation client et engagement à offrir une expérience client exceptionnelle. 

Certification ITIL Foundation ou expérience équivalente en gestion des services. 

Maîtrise de Microsoft Office et des outils de productivité d’entreprise. 

Familiarité avec les outils d’intelligence artificielle, tels que Claude et Microsoft Copilot. 

Qualifications souhaitées 

Expérience dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants constitue un atout:

Systèmes d’exploitation Linux, macOS et Windows 

Langages de programmation comme Java ou C# 

Technologies de script et technologies Web, notamment XML, HTML, JSON, CSS et XSLT 

Bases de données, notamment Oracle, MariaDB et Microsoft SQL Server 

Serveurs d’applications et serveurs Web comme Apache, JBoss, WebSphere et WebLogic 

Services Web REST et SOAP 

Technologies mobiles Android et iOS 

Compétences linguistiques additionnelles, particulièrement en espagnol et/ou en français 

 Critère de réussite 

Performance de l’équipe 

Respecter ou dépasser les engagements de niveau de service établis pour les incidents de priorité 1 et de priorité 2. 

Atteindre les niveaux de service mondiaux de gestion des incidents dans un modèle de soutien continu. 

Résoudre ou fournir une solution de contournement acceptable pour au moins 85 % des incidents critiques dans un délai d’une semaine. 

Veiller à ce que les incidents de priorité 1 et de priorité 2 fassent l’objet de mises à jour conformément aux normes de communication et aux procédures d’escalade établies. 

Maintenir un taux de satisfaction de la clientèle (CCSAT) de 4,0/5 ou plus. 

 Performance individuelle 

Cerner, mettre en œuvre et présenter les résultats d’initiatives d’amélioration des services chaque trimestre. 

Favoriser des améliorations mesurables en matière de réponse aux incidents, de qualité des communications, d’efficacité opérationnelle et de satisfaction client. 

Pourquoi vous joindre à OneSpan? 

Chez OneSpan, vous ferez partie d’une équipe qui aide les plus grandes organisations au monde à protéger les interactions numériques et à bâtir la confiance. Vous aurez l’occasion de diriger lors de moments critiques, d’influencer l’excellence opérationnelle et d’avoir un impact concret sur la réussite des clients au quotidien. 

Ce poste exige que les candidats résident dans la région de Montréal, puisqu’il suit un modèle de travail hybride de 2 jours par semaine au bureau. 

OneSpan est un employeur qui souscrit au principe de l’égalité d’accès à l’emploi. Pour en savoir plus, veuillez visiter notre Centre de confidentialité.

Senior Incident Manager 

OneSpan is seeking a high-performing Senior Incident Manager to join our Montreal team. OneSpan helps organizations transform how they secure, sign, and manage agreements through industry-leading solutions for digital identity verification, eSignature, smart forms, digital notarization, and security.

Major Incident Management

Lead incident response activities, ensuring rapid engagement of the appropriate technical and business stakeholders. 

Coordinate regional activities for global, follow-the-sun incidents. 

Facilitate incident bridges, stakeholder communications, and post-incident reviews. 

Drive incidents to resolution while maintaining focus on customer impact and business continuity.

Analyze ticket data, operational trends, and support metrics to identify improvement opportunities.

Establish and drive continuous improvement initiatives across people, processes, tools, and technology. 

Ensure compliance with global support standards, operational procedures, and best practices. 

Reporting & Performance Management 

Develop and maintain KPI dashboards, reports, and executive summaries. 

Track incident trends, service performance, and improvement initiatives. 

Report regularly on operational health, customer impact, and process improvement progress. 

Customer Advocacy 

Act as a trusted customer advocate during critical situations. 

Deliver clear, timely, and transparent communication throughout the incident lifecycle. 

Ensure the security, confidentiality, and integrity of customer systems and information at all times. 

What You Bring 

Required Qualifications 

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 

6+ years of experience in Customer Support, Technical Support, Incident Management, or Service Operations. 

Experience supporting SaaS, cloud-based, cybersecurity, or enterprise software solutions. 

Strong knowledge of incident management and service management practices. 

Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage technical and executive audiences. 

Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. 

Highly customer-focused with a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences. 

ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent Service Management experience. 

Proficiency with Microsoft Office and business productivity tools. 

Familiar with AI tools – Claude, Co-Pilot etc 

Preferred Qualifications 

Experience in one or more of the following areas: 

Linux, macOS, and Windows operating systems 

Programming languages such as Java or C# 

Scripting and web technologies including XML, HTML, JSON, CSS, and XSLT 

Databases including Oracle, MariaDB, and Microsoft SQL Server 

Application and web servers such as Apache, JBoss, WebSphere, and WebLogic 

REST and SOAP web services 

Mobile technologies (Android and iOS) 

Additional language proficiency, particularly Spanish and/or French 

Success Measures 

Team Performance 

Meet or exceed service level commitments for Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents. 

Achieve global incident management service levels within a follow-the-sun support model. 

Resolve or provide an acceptable workaround for at least 85% of critical incidents within one week. 

Ensure Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents are updated according to communication standards and escalation procedures. 

Maintain a Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) score of 4.0/5 or higher. 

Individual Performance 

Identify, execute, and report on service improvement initiatives each quarter. 

Drive measurable improvements in incident response, communication quality, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. 

Why Join OneSpan? 

At OneSpan, you'll be part of a team dedicated to helping the world's leading organizations protect digital interactions and build trust. You'll have the opportunity to lead through critical moments, influence operational excellence, and make a meaningful impact on customer success every day. 

This position requires candidates to reside in the Montreal area, as it follows a hybrid work model with 2 days per week in the office.

• BCDR Support: Supply DR exercise/continuity evidence for client requests; support BIA cycles and tabletop exercises.
• Reporting & Automation: Produce recurring KPI/leadership reporting. Identify manual control work suitable for automation (asset inventory, ticket creation, evidence extraction, training reporting) and build/commission agentic workflows, with SOPs for each.

Verifying features against their design specs and acceptance criteria, and catching the deltas between what was designed vs. what was built.

Working with developers, designers and product to build quality into features before the code is written.

job_responsibilities:

• Process and manage end-to-end payroll for multiple US-based entities, including regular, off-cycle, and ad hoc payroll runs
• Ensure accurate calculation of wages, deductions, garnishments, tax withholdings, and all payroll-related transactions

AI & Agentic Engineer, Senior
Montréal, Quebec, Canada
Artefact is a next-generation data and AI consulting firm dedicated to accelerating the adoption of data and AI to create measurable business impact across the full enterprise value chain.
We sit at the intersection of consulting, data science, AI technologies, data engineering, and digital transformation. We do not just advise — we build, implement, and deliver results our clients can measure. Our teams bring together consultants, data scientists, data engineers, AI engineers, analysts, and digital experts to solve complex business challenges with pragmatic, production-ready solutions.
As Artefact continues to grow globally, we are building a team of entrepreneurial data and AI talent who can help clients move beyond experimentation and into scalable, governed, value-generating AI adoption.
The Role
Artefact is looking for a Senior AI & Agentic Engineer: a full-stack engineer who takes AI features from idea to production.
You will design and build the interfaces, services, and agentic systems at the heart of our client work, such as conversational applications over enterprise data, multi-step agents that automate business workflows, and the retrieval and data pipelines that support them. You will own your components end to end: the React front end, the Python or Node service behind it, the RAG pipeline feeding it, and the evaluations proving it works.
This role combines breadth and depth: the ability to take a feature from front end to cloud deployment, together with strong expertise in at least one major AI platform — Google (Gemini), Anthropic (Claude), or OpenAI.
You will work with direct client exposure, and you will support the professional development of the junior engineers around you.
What You'll Do
Build Full-Stack AI Applications, End to End
You will build AI products across the entire stack, from interface to infrastructure.
Develop user-facing interfaces in TypeScript/React and the backend services and APIs behind them in Python or Node.
Implement agentic behavior: orchestration, tool and function calling, memory, and guardrails.
Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid search.
Connect AI systems to enterprise data and applications via APIs, semantic layers, and protocols such as MCP.
Make AI Systems Production-Grade
Our standard is production quality: systems that are reliable, monitored, and maintainable.
Write evaluation suites and regression tests for LLM-powered features, and monitor cost, latency, and quality in production.
Apply solid engineering practice: version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, and observability.
Deploy on cloud infrastructure (GCP, Azure, or AWS) using containers, serverless, and infrastructure-as-code.
Build and maintain the data pipelines that feed AI systems, across warehouses, lakehouses, and vector stores.
Work AI-Natively and Client-Facing
Our engineers work AI-natively and represent Artefact directly with clients.
Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor) daily, with good judgment about verification and review.
Communicate progress, trade-offs, and blockers clearly to clients and project leads.
Support pre-sales when needed: scope solutions, build demos, and estimate effort with our partnership and consulting teams.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to internal accelerators, reusable components, and engineering standards.
What We're Looking For
Required Experience
3–5 years of experience in software engineering or data engineering, with extensive hands-on use of AI tools and LLM-based development over the past year (professional projects, internal initiatives, or substantial personal builds).
Professional English proficiency mandatory. You will work daily with international clients and colleagues.
Strong programming skills in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, and experience building and consuming APIs.
Experience with front-end development (React or similar) and at least one backend framework.
Hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings, and vector search, and with at least one agentic framework (LangGraph/LangChain, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK, or OpenAI Agents SDK).
Specialization in at least one major AI platform ecosystem — Google (Gemini, Vertex AI, Gemini Enterprise), Anthropic (Claude, Managed Agents, MCP), or OpenAI (Responses API, AgentKit) — and working experience with one cloud platform (GCP, Azure, or AWS).
Fluency with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, or Cursor.
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Certifications
A certification on at least one major AI platform or cloud is a strong differentiator at application. If you do not hold one yet, obtaining one within your first 2 months in the role is a requirement — Artefact sponsors the exam and gives you time to prepare.
Examples: Claude Certified Developer – Foundations (Anthropic), Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Google Cloud Generative AI Leader, Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate, or equivalent AWS credentials.
Preferred Experience
Experience with MCP servers, multi-agent patterns, or LLM evaluation tooling (LangSmith, Langfuse, promptfoo).
Experience with Terraform or CI/CD pipelines.
Key Capabilities
A strong candidate will bring:
Breadth across the full stack, with depth in at least one AI platform
Owns features end to end, from interface to infrastructure
Cares about evaluation and reliability, not just the happy path
Communicates clearly in demos, documents, and code review
Client-facing mindset: understands client needs and translates business requirements into technical solutions
Learns new tools and models fast, and shares what works
Why Join Artefact
At Artefact, data and AI are not abstract strategy topics. They are tools for creating business value, improving organizations, and helping people make better decisions.
You will join a global community of data and AI experts who combine consulting, engineering, data science, marketing, and technology expertise. You will work on complex, high-impact problems with leading organizations and help shape how enterprises adopt AI responsibly and effectively.
We value action, collaboration, learning, client trust, and shared knowledge. We believe that technology only matters when it is used, adopted, and translated into impact.
Our values aren't decorations on a wall — they're how we actually work:
There is always a way — We're builders and problem-solvers. An idea only counts if it gets executed.
Client trust is won in the field — We show up, sleeves rolled up, working side by side with our clients.
If it's not used, it's useless — We build for adoption and impact, not for slide decks.
If it's not shared, we're not done — Knowledge shared compounds. We invest in each other's growth.
We learn every day — In a field that moves this fast, standing still means falling behind. We embrace the challenge.
How We Support Our People
In addition to our values-driven culture, we offer a range of benefits and programs designed to support our employees' growth and well-being, including:
Learning and Development: Work alongside a multidisciplinary team of AI, data, and consulting experts who are committed to continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional growth.
Hybrid Flexibility: Our hybrid work model gives you the flexibility to balance collaboration, client needs, and personal commitments.
Comprehensive Benefits: We offer a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company matching, and paid parental leave.
Time to Recharge: We believe sustainable performance matters. That's why we offer unlimited paid time off, giving you the flexibility to take the time you need.
Growth Opportunities: As a rapidly growing organization, you'll have the opportunity to expand your skills, take on new challenges, and help shape the future of the company.

job_summary: Develop and deploy statistical and machine-learning models, evaluate LLM systems, and translate analytical findings into client decisions. The role asks for 3–5 years of relevant data-science experience, Python and SQL proficiency, and a quantitative master’s degree or equivalent experience, while accepting substantial personal LLM projects. The application requires three on-site days each week, Tuesday through Thursday, in the advertised city.
job_responsibilities:
• Translate business and marketing challenges into analytical use cases with clear hypotheses and success metrics.
• Develop statistical and machine learning models: regression, forecasting, classification, clustering, and causal inference.
• Select techniques based on business context, constraints, and data availability — and be able to justify the choice.
• Ship production-ready solutions: training, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing refinement.
• Run fine-tuning experiments: dataset curation, SFT, LoRA/PEFT, and rigorous evaluation of results against baselines.
• Build evaluation suites for LLM systems: benchmarks, LLM-as-judge patterns, and regression tests.
• Work with embeddings and retrieval where they affect answer quality.
• Contribute to model selection decisions: prompting vs. RAG vs. fine-tuning, cost vs. quality vs. latency.
• Build data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and quality assurance across diverse data sources.
• Create clear visualizations and dashboards that support data storytelling and decision making.
• Present findings to client stakeholders, translating methodology into business language.
• Mentor junior data scientists and use AI-assisted tools (Claude Code, Gemini CLI) to raise the whole team's pace.
experience_required:
• 3–5 years of relevant data science experience with a substantial quantitative skill set.
• Strong knowledge of statistics and ML algorithms, with at least one proven experience developing and deploying models.
• Proficiency in Python (scikit-learn, XGBoost; PyTorch a strong plus) and solid SQL.
• Hands-on experience with LLMs: evaluation, RAG, or fine-tuning experiments (professional or substantial personal projects).
• Specialization in at least one major AI platform ecosystem — Google (Gemini, Vertex AI), Anthropic (Claude), or OpenAI — and familiarity with a cloud platform (GCP, Azure, or AWS).
• Comfort with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or Cursor.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills: you can present methodology and results to non-technical audiences.
• Master's degree (or higher) in statistics/mathematics, engineering, computer science, economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• Preferred: Causal inference, time series, or advanced statistics experience.
• Preferred: Hugging Face Transformers, LoRA/PEFT, or open-weight model experience.
• Preferred: MLOps exposure: model versioning, pipelines, monitoring.
• Preferred: Cloud certifications, especially Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer.

job_summary: Evaluate and rank AI outputs, create training datasets, apply rubrics and report model failures across text, images and structured data. job_responsibilities:
• Evaluate and rank model outputs: Complete preference and comparison tasks, assessing which responses best conform to project guidelines for accuracy, helpfulness, tone, and safety, and writing clear justifications for your judgments.
• Stress-test and break models: Probe models adversarially to surface failure modes, unsafe behavior, and capability gaps, and document reproducible cases that engineering and research teams can act on.
• Create datasets: Author high-quality prompts, responses, and exemplars to build training and evaluation datasets, following detailed specifications and editing machine-written or human-written outputs to standard.
• Build and apply rubrics and taxonomies: Contribute to the design of grading criteria and rubrics, then apply them consistently to produce structured, high-quality annotations across task types.
• Annotate and correct multimodal data: Label, audit, and rectify inaccuracies across text, image, and structured data, maintaining a high standard of data integrity and accuracy.
• Calibrate and maintain consistency: Participate in calibration exercises and inter-annotator agreement checks to align on standards, and flag ambiguous or uncovered edge cases rather than guessing, since a single misjudgment replicated at scale degrades a model.
• Adapt to experimental work: Take on new and evolving task types as project needs shift, applying sound judgment in areas where guidelines are still being developed.
• Report on model performance: Surface and communicate quality and performance trends in model and agent behavior, giving cross-functional partners clear, well-evidenced feedback on where models succeed, fail, and degrade.
experience_required:
• 1+ years of experience in AI data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, research, or a related analytical role, with exposure to quality assurance, and/or preference ranking.
• Experience applying detailed guidelines to complex and often ambiguous content, with strong contextual and sociocultural judgment, sensitivity to nuance, tone, and register, and the ability to reason well in cases where there is no single correct answer.
• Comfort with ambiguity: a willingness to flag unclear or uncovered edge cases rather than guess, and to work productively on novel, experimental tasks whose definitions are still evolving.
• A sharp, curious eye for inconsistencies, subtle errors, and model failure modes, including the instinct to probe models adversarially and surface where they break. Familiarity with how large language models behave, such as hallucination, sycophancy, and instruction-following gaps, is a plus.
• Excellent command of written English and strong reading comprehension, with the ability to clearly justify your evaluations, including why an output is correct or incorrect, high-quality or low-quality, and to write clear prompts and exemplars that explain your reasoning. Bonus points if you are fluent in another language!
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, with the ability to maintain consistency across high-volume and monotonous tasks.
• Comfort working with annotation platforms and structured formats such as JSON, CSV/TSV, Markdown, XML, and YAML.
• Strong execution in a remote environment, including good time management, comfort using new tools, and the ability to work independently in a global, asynchronous team.

Buyers used to start on Google. Now they ask ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini which vendors to trust. Getting recommended by an AI assistant is a different problem from ranking on a search page — some people call it Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), some call it AEO, and the field hasn't agreed on a name yet. That's how early this is.
At Flexspring — the leading expert in HR data integration — we're investing in it now rather than waiting for the playbook to be written.
You'll work directly with our VP of Marketing and SEO Specialist across both halves of the job: the SEO discipline that's thirty years old and well understood, and the AI-search side that's about two years old and largely unmapped. You'll run experiments, analyze results, and help build our approach. You'll own real projects and leave with a portfolio that shows measurable business impact.

Run keyword research and build the topic clusters and content roadmap that come out of it

Use AI tools to accelerate research, competitive analysis, and reporting

2–5 years of experience in digital or performance marketing.

Working knowledge of  SEO, email marketing, and affiliate marketing .
Strong analytical skills with experience using  GA4, Looker Studio, Excel , or similar reporting tools.
Experience leveraging AI-powered marketing tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to improve campaign creation, optimization, content development, and operational efficiency.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities.
Curious, proactive, and passionate about continuous learning and optimization.

Knak is a mission-driven company

Why? Because our time is limited, our competition is fierce, and our margin for error is small. To have the biggest impact on the world, we stay focused on our core mission, which is...

Empowering marketers to be creative.

That’s why Knak exists.

In a world where AI has made everyone a creator, Knak helps marketers turn ideas into on-brand, high-performing campaigns at scale. The world's most AI-forward companies, including Meta, OpenAI, NVIDIA, and Stripe, use Knak as their agentic marketing production platform.

Here's what they figured out: creation got easy, but that’s making production harder. Every new idea and brief still has to be built, versioned, checked, approved, and shipped across every channel, and that work runs on handoffs, review cycles, and a lot of copy-paste. That middle stretch of the marketing stack has no system, no standard, and no owner.

Knak is the flexible factory for that work. Our customers set the brand rules, choose the tools that feed in and the platforms that send, and decide where AI does the work and where people do. We handle the repeatable parts, so marketers get their time back for the parts that aren't.

Knak is a mission-driven company

Why? Because our time is limited, our competition is fierce, and our margin for error is small. To have the biggest impact on the world, we stay focused on our core mission, which is...

Empowering marketers to be creative.

That’s why Knak exists.

In a world where AI has made everyone a creator, Knak helps marketers turn ideas into on-brand, high-performing campaigns at scale. The world's most AI-forward companies, including Meta, OpenAI, NVIDIA, and Stripe, use Knak as their agentic marketing production platform.

Here's what they figured out: creation got easy, but that’s making production harder. Every new idea and brief still has to be built, versioned, checked, approved, and shipped across every channel, and that work runs on handoffs, review cycles, and a lot of copy-paste. That middle stretch of the marketing stack has no system, no standard, and no owner.

Knak is the flexible factory for that work. Our customers set the brand rules, choose the tools that feed in and the platforms that send, and decide where AI does the work and where people do. We handle the repeatable parts, so marketers get their time back for the parts that aren't.

We're built by marketers, for marketers. We started with email because it's the hardest channel to get right and where many campaigns win or lose. Now we're bringing that same production discipline to every channel our customers use.

The Role: Senior Software Developer, AI Agents

We’re looking for an experienced software developer to build and scale the  AI agents behind Knak’s platform. In this role you'll develop the agent harness itself: the orchestration, tool calling, context management, and guardrails that let agents analyze data, generate complex marketing assets, and deliver real value to our customers. You'll also ensure we know they work, by building the evaluation suites that measure agent quality and catch regressions before they reach customers.

Create AI microservices : Build Python and Node.js services for agent hosting and LLM interaction.

Build reliable APIs : Develop and maintain the Laravel (PHP) APIs that integrate agents into the Knak platform, ensuring testability, observability, and performance.

Deploy to the cloud : Use AWS services (Lambda, Bedrock, CDN delivery) to build secure, scalable infrastructure for agents.

Optimize databases : Tune MySQL queries and indexing to improve speed and reduce latency.

Elevate code quality : Lead and participate in code reviews, maintaining high standards across the team.

Collaborate cross-functionally : Work with product, design, QA, and DevOps to align solutions with business needs.

Mentor engineers : Share knowledge on agent development and evaluation practices, and set a high bar for technical excellence.

full_job_post:
MongoDB powers mission‑critical workloads for customers who expect their data to be durable, highly available, and fast to access. The Storage Execution team builds the core infrastructure that makes those guarantees real.

We are hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to manage the largely New York-based Storage Execution team. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who is obsessed with customer success, takes the responsibility of durably storing customer data seriously, and has strong empathy for both their team and our users.

This role can be based remotely in Ontario, Canada.

About the Storage Execution team

The Storage Execution team sits at the heart of MongoDB’s Online Transaction Processing (OLTP) team. We own the core transactional read/write path on each node, across both today’s storage engine and a next‑generation cloud-native storage architecture. Our work determines how correct and performant MongoDB is for customers running mission-critical production workloads.

The team’s responsibilities include:

• Defining and maintaining the internal collection and index APIs used by Replication, Query and Catalog modules, and commands for local reads and writes, plus the transaction and durability primitives that govern visibility, conflict resolution and crash recovery

• Integrating the next generation of MongoDB’s storage architecture into the server in a way that is predictable for other teams, scales with cloud elasticity, and preserves the performance and safety of the classic configuration

• Improving transaction processing speed and semantics of both single shard and cross-shard transactions

• Owning index builds and schema‑level storage operations (build/rebuild, cleanup, resumability) and ensuring they behave well for large, highly available clusters running write-heavy workloads

• Building validation, diagnostics, and storage‑focused test infrastructure to catch durability issues early and keep the system trustworthy at scale

• Partnering with neighboring teams on flow control, prioritization and load-shedding to stay within resource limits, protecting durability and availability at the cluster level without starving critical operations

What you’ll do

• Lead, grow and manage a New York–based team of 8 to 10 engineers; ensure clear expectations, high standards, and healthy, sustainable execution

• Own the team’s roadmap across durability, availability, performance, and developer productivity, in partnership with OLTP leadership and Product Management

• Manage customer escalations involving storage behavior and durability; work directly with Support, Atlas, and other server teams to reproduce, root‑cause, and resolve issues

• Drive process and tooling improvements that raise engineering velocity and code quality (e.g., ownership, review expectations, customer escalation and build failure practices)

• Partner closely with Replication, Query, Sharding, Catalog & Routing, Storage Engines, and Atlas teams on cross‑team features such as the new storage architecture, availability improvements, and workload management

• Represent Storage Execution in planning, staffing, and calibration; make thoughtful tradeoffs between near‑term deliverables, longer‑term availability gaps, and platform investments

Candidate profile

• 8+ years building, debugging, and tuning distributed and/or highly concurrent systems software (databases, storage engines, filesystems, or similar)

• 2+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring, performance management, and coaching across a range of levels

• Willing to work East Coast hours

• Strong proficiency in at least one compiled, statically-typed language such as C++, Rust, or Go; prior C++ and systems programming experience is a plus

• Deep understanding of durability, availability, and performance tradeoffs in distributed systems; experience with replication, consensus, storage engines, or transactional systems is highly desirable

• Demonstrated customer obsession: direct experience working with demanding customers (or customer support / cloud teams) on complex incidents and turning them into clear, outcome‑oriented recommendations

• Proven ability to develop people: mentoring and promoting engineers, managing underperformance directly, and building high‑engagement teams with low regretted attrition

• Comfortable leading multi‑quarter initiatives with multiple stakeholders and using written documents to align teams on design, scope, and tradeoffs

Success measures

In three months, you have:

• Built strong relationships with your team and key partner teams

• Taken over team ceremonies, short‑term planning, and on‑call responsibilities

• Co‑led at least one active project and shipped one concrete process improvement

In six to twelve months, you have:

• Led at least one cross‑team initiative in availability, durability, or developer velocity

• Delivered a multi‑quarter project with clear impact on durability/availability or team throughput

• Built a bench of engineers ready for increased scope and, over time, leadership roles

● Build and deploy LLM-based agents for lead scoring, content recommendation, and competitive monitoring, with appropriate evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop checkpoints where the business requires them
● Construct the data pipeline that connects CRM, intent data, web analytics, and ad platforms into a unified, continuously updating signal
● Operate the system in production: monitor performance, debug failures, retrain models, and iterate on agent logic as market and business conditions evolve
● Define and track performance metrics across all capabilities; report outcomes to the CMO and Revenue leadership
● Collaborate closely with Sales to understand what pipeline intelligence actually moves deals, and build to that signal
● Work with the broader marketing team to ensure the system integrates with campaigns, events, and content workflows
REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
Experience
● 6–8 years of professional experience across marketing technology, revenue operations, growth engineering, or a related discipline — a software engineering background is not required, but you must be capable of building and shipping production systems
● Demonstrated track record of building and operating a production-grade agentic marketing system at a financial technology firm or a company in a highly regulated industry — this is a firm requirement
● Proven B2B experience; you understand enterprise sales cycles, account-based marketing, and how pipeline intelligence translates into closed revenue
● Experience deploying and operating cloud-based production systems — you are comfortable owning infrastructure decisions and accountable for uptime
Domain Knowledge
● Deep understanding of B2B financial services — how capital markets firms buy software, what they care about, and how compliance and procurement constraints shape the sales cycle
● Genuine, demonstrable interest in AI — you follow the field, have opinions on tooling and architecture, and have applied LLMs to real business problems in production
Technical Fluency
● Fluent in modern marketing technology — you can evaluate, integrate, and orchestrate the tools that make an agentic revenue system work, including platforms across paid media, analytics, cloud infrastructure, AI, CRM, and data warehousing (such as Google Ads, GA4, Google Cloud, Claude, Salesforce, and Snowflake)
● Able to design and implement LLM-based agents and agentic workflows, including evaluation, guardrails, and observability in production
● Strong working knowledge of CRM data models and marketing/revenue data stacks
● Capable of evaluating model output quality and building appropriate human-in-the-loop review processes for business-critical automation
NICE TO HAVE
● Prior experience with intent data platforms or programmatic advertising ecosystems
● Familiarity with headless content architectures and CMS tooling
● Bilingual English/French — working language of the role is English; French is an asset in Montreal
THE TEAM
You will join a lean in-house marketing team supported by five specialist agencies covering PR & content, social media, creative and advertising, operations, and video production. The CMO oversees strategy, budget, and executive alignment. This is a senior individual contributor role — no direct reports at outset, with scope to grow as the system matures.
WHY TS IMAGINE?
● On-site role—4 days per week in our Montreal office, with 1 day of flexibility.
● Unlimited vacation + 3 personal days.
● Annual bonus and salary review.
● $1,500 training budget to fuel your growth.
● RRSP matching (3% company contribution).
● Comprehensive health insurance.
● Subsidized public transportation (Opus & Cie).
Note: This role is not remote—applicants must be based in Montreal.
ABOUT TS IMAGINE
TS Imagine builds the technology the world's most sophisticated financial institutions rely on to trade across every asset class, manage risk in real time, and run their financing businesses. Execution, order management, risk, and financing all run on one platform with the same governed data foundation and proprietary ontology, giving clients a single trusted view of their business and actionable, explainable intelligence they can defend to regulators, counterparties, and compliance teams.
Clients include global banks, asset managers, hedge funds, and prime brokers operating across equities, fixed income, FX, derivatives, and crypto. TS Imagine delivers this through TSIQ: AI-powered intelligence grounded entirely in each client's own data. Headquartered in New York with 13 offices worldwide.

full_job_post:
Review the details of this job and apply below.

Data Analyst

Summary

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our diverse and rapidly growing team in Montreal. The successful applicant will be responsible for leveraging client data to produce rapid insights through automated reporting and custom analytics. This individual has experience manipulating large and often complex datasets, both structured and unstructured. We are looking for individuals from a wide range of backgrounds with demonstrated quantitative and problem-solving skills. We value creativity, hard work and on-the-job excellence. The ideal candidate is someone who is highly motivated, detail oriented, curious and who seeks to take on a challenging role. We need someone who can work effectively with members of our data engineering, research and digital teams to deliver data-driven products to organizations.

Key Responsibilities

- Translate a client’s overarching business objectives into requirements and then into discrete projects that aim to provide insight and/or generate eﬃciencies.
- Access, understand, query, and transform data from a large variety of data sources, each with its own set of intricacies.
- Design, develop, and deploy custom automated reporting solutions with the goal of providing clients with rapid, actionable insights.
- Design and coordinate experimental protocols in various departments to identify strategic eﬃciencies.
- Communicate insights and methodologies clearly and succinctly to both technical and lay audiences.
- Special projects, and other duties as required.

Candidate Qualifications

- Strong problem solving skills.
- 2+ years experience writing complex SQL queries to transform and extract data from relational databases or data warehouses.
- Experience writing R and/or Python code aimed at manipulating and analyzing large datasets.
- Understanding of statistical principles.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Fully bilingual in English and French.
- Ability to coordinate across teams.
Knowledge of English is required for this position as the incumbent will be required to interact daily with a predominantly English-speaking clientele located outside of Quebec.

We’re excited by candidates who enjoy and are capable of working in a fast-growing entrepreneurial environment. Your ultimate goal is to ensure we build our platform in a pragmatic, scalable and sustainable way.
We are looking for an engineer who embraces modern AI tools as a core part of their development workflow.
